bloating

diarrhea

gas

item_data.name: Chickweed
item_data.description:
Chickweed has been used in ancient folk medicine recorded as far back as the 16th century when it was often used to treat wounds, a skin condition called?psoriasis,?rabies, itching, plus muscle and?joint pain. Over time, it was embraced as a "blood cleanser" and sometimes used to treat asthma, constipation, menstrual pain, peptic ulcers, rabies, respiratory illnesses, obesity, and scurvy, vitamin c deficiency, among other common and uncommon conditions.. The leaf is used to make medicine.

When applied topically in DIY infusions, chickweed is believed to treat the following skin conditions:

Burns

Contact dermatitis

Diaper rash

Eczema

Insect bites

Itchy skin

Psoriasis

Rashes

Wounds

Splinters


Chickweed is sometimes applied directly to the skin for many skin problems.

It is also used in foods, chickweed is eaten in salads or served as cooked green in certain culture

Our line of New Herbie Ayurvedic Infusions aims to combine the ancient wisdom of herbs to educate, nature, ease, & support promoting balance between the mind, body and spirit elements.

-Vata dosha relates most directly to one's mental state, a Vata sleep disorder commonly presents itself in a restless mind, creating an inability to fall into a deep sleep, which can be counteracted with soothing lavender.

-Kapha dosha typically effect one's ability to recover from sleep; often times leaving one feeling lethargic and groggy after a full night's rest, which is best counteracted with chamomile.

?-Pitta dosha are more emotional in nature, but tend to present themselves biologically while interrupting sleep with symptoms that may include hot flashes, which can be avoided with the use of cooling gotu kola.

So make sure to do your own research on Ayurveda.?

item_data.name: Elderberry Tincture
item_data.description:
Nature?s ultimate seasonal defender, concentrated for daily resilience.
When your system needs an extra layer of protection against environmental stressors, look no further than the deep purple power of the European Black Elderberry (Sambucus nigra). Our Elderberry Tincture delivers the concentrated wellness of this time-tested botanical in a travel-friendly, fast-acting liquid format.

Elderberries are celebrated for their exceptionally high concentration of anthocyanins and vitamin C, making them an absolute powerhouse for neutralizing free radicals and reinforcing cellular health. Instead of sugary syrups, our clean tincture format offers a pure, potent extract that assimilates quickly into your system. It is the perfect daily ritual to keep your immune defenses robust and your body thriving through every changing season.

Key Benefits
Year-Round Immune Backing: Provides targeted nourishment to support and strengthen your body?s natural immune response.
Antioxidant Powerhouse: Packed with dark berry flavonoids that combat everyday oxidative stress and support cellular longevity.
Upper Respiratory Support: Helps maintain healthy respiratory function, keeping you feeling clear and vibrant during seasonal transitions.
Pure & Sugar-Free: All the defensive benefits of fresh elderberries without the added sugars, artificial thickeners, or preservatives found in commercial syrups.

Pure Ingredients
Organic Black Elderberry (Sambucus nigra) fruit
Organic Cane Alcohol (extraction agent)

Suggested Use
For Daily Maintenance: Take 1 dropperful (approx. 30 drops) in water or juice, 1 to 2 times daily.
For Extra Seasonal Support: Take 1 to 2 dropperfuls up to 4 times daily, or as recommended by your holistic health professional.
Shake well before use. Store in a cool, dark place.

Regulatory Note: These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Consult your healthcare provider before use if you are pregnant, nursing, or taking regular medications.

item_data.name: Ginger Tincture
item_data.description:
Ignite your inner warmth and restore natural digestive harmony.
Bring the fiery, revitalizing power of fresh ginger root into your daily wellness routine. Our Ginger Tincture is a highly concentrated liquid extract made from premium Zingiber officinale rhizomes. Prized for centuries across traditional global herbalism, ginger is renowned for its ability to spark healthy digestion, diffuse occasional stomach tension, and fill the body with a comforting, vitalizing warmth.

Rich in active, pungent compounds called gingerols and shogaols, this tincture provides immediate, fast-acting support wherever you go. Whether you need a post-meal digestive aid to ease occasional bloating or a reliable travel companion for a bumpy road trip, this pocket-sized extract delivers the pure essence of ginger without the need for brewing tea or peeling roots.

Key Benefits
Optimal Digestive Support: Soothes the digestive tract, encouraging smooth, comfortable digestion and helping to ease occasional gas or bloating.
The Ultimate Travel Companion: Helps maintain stomach comfort and eases occasional nausea or motion uneasiness during flights, boat rides, or road trips.
Stimulates Healthy Circulation: Promotes vital, healthy blood flow and delivers a comforting, warming sensation throughout the body.
Daily Metabolic & Immune Backing: Packed with antioxidant properties that support metabolic vitality and fortify your body's natural defenses.

Pure Ingredients
Organic Ginger (Zingiber officinale) rhizome
Organic Cane Alcohol (extraction agent)

Suggested Use
For Post-Meal Comfort: Take 1 dropperful (approx. 30 drops) in a small glass of warm water or tea after heavy meals, up to 3 times daily.
For Travel & Motion Support: Take 1 dropperful 30 minutes before boarding or embarking on travel.
Shake well before use. Store in a cool, dark place.

Regulatory Note: These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Consult your healthcare provider before use if you are pregnant, nursing, taking medications (especially blood thinners), or have a history of gallstones.

Expertly crafted to provide concentrated liquid immune and cardiovascular support, our formula bypasses the harsh taste of raw garlic while ensuring rapid absorption. Capture the time-tested health benefits of garlic without the prep work or the intense odor. Our extraction process preserves the delicate sulfur compounds responsible for garlic's legendary wellness properties, giving you a potent supplement that works efficiently.
Key Wellness Benefits
Robust Immune System Support: Packed with natural antioxidants, regular use helps strengthen your body?s natural seasonal defenses.
